source.title: Timer ran in slow mode
source.content: A competitor set a time of 7.51 seconds. When checking the video of the solve, it was clear that the solve took more than 7 seconds. The timer was checked and it was found that the timer would stop for a while after lifting both hands. The timer was removed and an extra attempt was granted by the Delegate.

translation.title: 计时器运行偏慢
translation.content: 一名选手取得了 7.51 秒的成绩。查看还原视频时，明显看出实际还原用时超过 7 秒。检查发现，双手抬起后计时器会停顿一段时间。该计时器被撤下，代表给予了额外尝试。
